job.job_description:
Hiring for One of the topmost MNC!!




ROLE: AI Engineer




Exp: 3 to 8 YRS




Location: Hyderabad, Chennai, Kolkata, Pune, Bengaluru




Work mode: 5 Days work from office




Notice Period: 0-60 Days Only




Job Summary

We are seeking a skilled AI Engineer with hands-on experience in Generative AI and Python to design, develop, and deploy AI-powered applications. The ideal candidate will have expertise in Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), prompt engineering, and modern AI frameworks. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to build scalable AI solutions that address real-world business challenges.




Key Responsibilities:

Design, develop, and deploy Generative AI applications using Python.
Build AI solutions leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs) such as GPT, Llama, Gemini, or Claude.
Develop and optimize Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines.
Create effective prompts and evaluate model performance.
Integrate AI models with applications using APIs and frameworks.
Work with vector databases for semantic search and knowledge retrieval.
Fine-tune, evaluate, and optimize AI models for performance and scalability.
Collaborate with data scientists, software engineers, and product teams to deliver AI-driven solutions.
Implement best practices for AI model deployment, monitoring, and security.
Stay current with emerging AI technologies and industry trends.



Required Skills:

Strong proficiency in Python programming.
Hands-on experience with Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs).
Experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face Transformers, or similar frameworks.
Knowledge of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
Experience with vector databases such as Pinecone, FAISS, ChromaDB, or Milvus.
Familiarity with REST APIs and AI model integration.
Understanding of prompt engineering and model evaluation.
Experience with Git and version control.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
